title: Save localization arrays and heatmaps
description: You inspect the archive entries and three selected belief images.

steps.description: You create artifacts and save run_data.npz. Named entries include actions, observations, true states, beliefs, smoothed beliefs, the decoded path, and maze arrays.
You define an image helper that draws the belief grid, saves the figure, and closes it. The helper hides the axes before saving.

steps.question: Does this block save every belief as an image?
steps.answer: It saves only the first, middle, and last beliefs. The middle index is len(beliefs)//2.

steps.description: You see run_data.npz and three PNG names in the recorded listing. belief_t8.png is the selected middle image in this run.
